subject: Euro Circuit Racer!
author: Xandu
body:
My favourite car is without no doubt the "Euro Circuit Racer" from Burnout 3: Takedown. You can see me driving it . 😃

-- The Creator --

subject: It's SUPER!
author: ZombieTron
body: Mine is the Super Assassin Super from Burnout 3. I have spent many happy hours in my blue super assassin running away from red Euro's! 🙂

subject: OH, I have fav's from all of them 'cept Burnout, lol.
author: SUFFUR
body:
Burnout 2- Roadster (the last one earned not the slow one, though I use that till I get the fast one, lol), Burnout 3 -Tuned Super, Revenge-Criterion 205, Paradise-Roadster/Hawker (stunt and speed).

I do like the Revenger Racer, Euro', Super Car, and can drive most of the cars from all the games, the Works is a nice car too. I go how cars drive and if I can pick them in black, or very dark blue as well.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Definitely the World Circuit
author: FrozenVapor
body: Definitely the World Circuit Racer. That car was fast as hell.
